# TempMail

> Self-hosted temporary email service with a JSON HTTP API, mailbox isolation per account, MX domain management and email retrieval.

## Documentation

- [Web API reference](/): Sign in and open the “API 接口文档” page for the complete API index and curl examples.
- [Health check](/health): Public service health endpoint.
- [Public configuration](/public/settings): Public site settings.
- [Public statistics](/public/stats): Public statistics.

## Authentication

Use `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` or `X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY` for `/api/*`.
Avoid `?api_key=` because URLs may appear in logs. API keys are sensitive; never put them in prompts or public documents.
Admin endpoints also require an admin account. `/health` and `/public/*` are public routes.

## Public endpoints

- `GET /health`: Health status.
- `GET /public/settings`: Public site settings.
- `GET /public/stats`: Public statistics.
- `POST /public/key-login`: JSON `{"api_key":"YOUR_API_KEY"}`. Can be disabled for non-admin accounts.
- `POST /public/register`: JSON `{"username":"example"}`, when registration is enabled.
- `GET /public/auth/linuxdo` and `GET /public/auth/github`: OAuth login, with callbacks.

## Authenticated endpoints

- `GET /api/me`: Current account.
- `GET /api/stats`: Stats.
- `GET /api/domains`: Domains; response `{"domains":[...]}`.
- `POST /api/domains/submit`: Submit domain for verification.
- `GET /api/domains/:id/status`: Domain verification status.
- `POST /api/mailboxes`: Create mailbox. Optional JSON fields `address`, `domain`, `mode` (`single` or `multi`). Response HTTP 201 `{"mailbox":{...}}`.
- `GET /api/mailboxes?page=1&size=20&search=`: Mailboxes for current account; 1-based pagination, max size 100; case-insensitive address substring search. Response `{"data":[...],"total":0,"page":1,"size":20}`.
- `DELETE /api/mailboxes/:id`: Delete mailbox.
- `GET /api/mailboxes/:id/emails?page=1&size=20`: List emails in mailbox.
- `GET /api/mailboxes/:id/emails/:email_id`: Email details; response `{"email":{...}}`.
- `DELETE /api/mailboxes/:id/emails/:email_id`: Delete email.

## Administrator endpoints

- `POST /api/admin/accounts`, `GET /api/admin/accounts`, `DELETE /api/admin/accounts/:id`
- `POST /api/admin/domains`, `POST /api/admin/domains/mx-import`, `POST /api/admin/domains/mx-register`, `POST /api/admin/domains/refresh-mx`
- `DELETE /api/admin/domains/:id`, `PUT /api/admin/domains/:id/toggle`, `GET /api/admin/domains/:id/status`
- `GET /api/admin/settings`, `PUT /api/admin/settings`

## Example

```sh
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' 'https://YOUR_HOST/api/me'
curl -X POST 'https://YOUR_HOST/api/mailboxes' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"mode":"single"}'
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' 'https://YOUR_HOST/api/mailboxes?page=1&size=20'
```

## Notes for agents

- Use exact routes and methods above. Replace `:id` and `:email_id` with UUIDs.
- Poll the mailbox email list to await delivery, with delays and a finite timeout.
- API errors usually return a JSON `error` string. Handle HTTP 400/401/403/404/409/429/500 and availability failures such as 503.
- Do not use internal delivery routes `/internal/*` from untrusted clients.
- Do not hard-code secrets or run account registration stress tests against production.

- `PUT /api/mailboxes/:id/favorite`: Mark featured mailbox with `{"favorite":true}` or unmark with false.
- `GET /api/mailboxes?favorites=true`: List only featured mailboxes.
- `POST /api/admin/telegram/test`: Admin-only Telegram test notification; requires saved Bot Token and Chat ID.
- Telegram alerts are configured in admin settings (`telegram_enabled`, `telegram_bot_token`, `telegram_chat_id`) and fire only for new email delivered to featured mailboxes.
